Tax Summary

The Tax Summary report provides a comprehensive overview of tax collected on sales and tax paid on purchases during a specified period.

This report is essential for understanding your tax position and preparing tax returns.

Report Contents

The report displays the following information for each tax code:

• Net Sales - Sales amounts before tax

• Tax on Sales - Tax amounts collected from customers

• Total Sales - Combined sales and tax amounts

• Net Purchases - Purchase amounts before tax

• Tax on Purchases - Tax amounts paid to suppliers

• Total Purchases - Combined purchases and tax amounts

• Tax Liability - The difference between tax collected and tax paid

Using the Report

Click on any Net Sales or Net Purchases amount to view the underlying transactions that make up that figure.

The report can be generated using either accrual basis or cash basis accounting methods, depending on your reporting requirements.

To customize this report, see: Tax Summary
